

This category provides a comprehensive list of all [[Aes Sedai]] currently known to have lived during the period known as [[After Breaking|After the Breaking]].  This era covers a time period of roughly 1350 years, beginning with the conclusion  of the [[Breaking of the World]] and ending with the final battle of the [[Trolloc Wars]].  Notable events that took place during this epoch include the construction of [[Rhuidean]], the founding of the [[White Tower]], the signing of the [[Ten Nations|Compact of the Ten Nations]], the construction of the great [[Ogier]] built cities of the world, and the devastation wrought by the [[Trolloc Wars]].
